|game_text=Deploy on a superlaser. May not fire at a planet until 'recharged.' Opponent may use Force (stacking it here); accumulating 8 Force recharges superlaser. When fired at a planet, Effect is canceled. If Effect canceled, accumulated Force is placed in Used Pile.
|errata_history=This E-marked PC image was present in the Holotable repository initial import of 8 July 2018. The import copied pre-existing images, so the face may be older. The 19 February 2023 image changes the recharge wording; the 3 July 2023 image changes the cancellation sentence from “planet” to “system”. See [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 3)]] and [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 4)]].
